details.room_type: Twin Room with Balcony or Terrace
details.description:
This adults-only hotel has a relaxed vibe for couples and friends – and it's in just the right spot for beaches, bars and restaurants.

This hotel – formerly known as the Bahia Princess – is in a great spot, with shops, bars and restaurants on its doorstep. There are a couple of beaches less than five minutes’ walk away, and upmarket Playa del Duque is close by, too.

With a main pool and two splash pools, and a fourth pool in the spa*, there are plenty of places to cool off here. Food-wise, you've got two restaurants to try, and a line-up of four bars are on hand for cocktails, coffees, ice-creams and snacks.

Due to health and safety reasons, mobility scooters aren't allowed in the hotel. You'll be able to park your mobility scooter in a designated area outside the main entrance of the hotel, with charging points*. If you have a Blue Badge, we'd recommend you take it on holiday with you. Manual and electric wheelchairs are fine to use inside and out.
